reasoning_chain: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
The question has three parts: the deadline for concluding the human review, the procedure that governs it, and the regulator the subscriber can go to if it does not happen.

[pdpl-45-2021-en:18(4)] only says the Controller shall include the human element in reviewing automated processing decisions at the Data Subject's request. It sets no time limit, no procedure and no escalation body.
[pdpl-45-2021-en:18(2)] only lists cases where the Data Subject may not object to automated decisions. It says nothing about review timing or regulators.
[pdpl-45-2021-en:23(2)] concerns the controls for transferring data outside the State, and [pdpl-45-2021-en:6(1)] concerns consent. Neither is relevant to the review deadline, procedure or regulator.

[pdpl-45-2021-en:7(5)] and [pdpl-45-2021-en:8(1)] concern Processor appointment and instructions. [tdra-cpr-v2-en:4.17.3] concerns voice-recorded consent, and [cabinet-66-2023-en:34(3)] concerns unfair contract terms. None of these sets a review deadline, procedure or complaint route.
No clause given names a regulator or a complaint route for a review that does not happen, so I will not infer a deadline, procedure or regulator.
